title.narrative: Strengthening health systems resilience in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: The purpose of this action is to contribute to mitigating the impact of COVID-19 in the region and improving the resilience of the Western Balkans against health emergencies. This will be accomplished through strengthening and maintaining all-hazard preparedness and response capacities across the region, strengthening health systems financing for universal health coverage, and supporting a robust preparedness for and implementation of impactful areas in the deployment of COVID-19 vaccines and vaccination.
